full_text_zh:
[P1] Chicka Chicka Boom Boom
叽喀叽喀
蹦蹦
[美] 小比尔·马丁
[美] 约翰·阿尔尚博 / 著
[美] 洛伊斯·埃勒特 / 绘
李一慢 / 译
光明日报出版社
1/17

[P2] A 告诉 B,
B 告诉 C,
“我们在椰子树顶见吧！”，
A told B,
and B told C,
“I’ll meet you at the top
of the coconut tree.”

[P3] “耶！
D 对 E F G 说，
“我要比你们先到达。”

“Whee!” said D
to E F G.
“I’ll beat you to the top
of the coconut tree.”

叽喀叽喀！蹦蹦！
树顶还能挤得下？
这时候，H 走过来，
也往树上爬，

Chicka chicka boom boom!
Will there be enough room?
Here comes H
up the coconut tree,

[P4] I 和 J 也来参加，
后面跟着 K，
一步一步
都往树上爬。

and I and J
and tag-along K,
all on their way
up the coconut tree.

叽喀叽喀！蹦蹦！
树顶还能挤得下？
看看谁来啦？
LMNOP！

Chicka chicka boom boom!
Will there be enough room?
Look who's coming!
L M N O P!

[P5] 有QRS！
And Q R S!
还有TUV！
And T U V!

[P6] 最后来的是 W！
和 X Y Z！
Still more—W!
And X Y Z!
所有字母都到齐，
都往树上爬——哎呀，糟糕！
The whole alphabet
up the—Oh, no!

[P7] 叽喀叽喀……
蹦！蹦！
Chicka chicka...
BOOM!
BOOM!

[P8] 你推我挤叽喳喳，
踢踢又踏踏。

每个人都跑到了椰子树下，
妈妈和爸爸，
舅舅和姑妈，
抱抱自己的小宝贝，
拍拍裤子上的沙。

Skit skat skoodle doot.
Flip flop flee.
Everybody running to the
coconut tree.
Mamas and papas
and uncles and aunts
hug their little dears,
then dust their pants.

[P9] ABC大声叫：
“快拉我们起来吧！ ”
“Help us up,”
cried A B C.

[P10] 字母堆里又爬出好几个：Next from the pileup
D 的膝盖碰破了皮，
skinned-knee D
E 的脚趾扭断了骨，
and stubbed-toe E
F 贴上了创可贴，
and patched-up F.
G 也拼命挤出来，
Then comes G
快要喘不上气。
all out of breath.

[P11] H 和 I 缠得分不开，
J 和 K 快要哭出来，
L 打结像领带。

H is tangled up with I.
J and K are about to cry.
L is knotted like a tie.

[P12] M 挤得腿打弯，
N 挤成驼背汉，
O 也挤得七扭八歪。
你推我挤叽喳喳，
踢踢又踏踏。
M is looped.
N is stooped.
O is twisted alley-oop.
Skit skat skoodle doot.
Flip flop flee.

[P13] 看看谁又出来了？
原来是
黑眼圈小P，
后面跟着QRS，
还有豁牙T。
Look who's coming!
It's black-eyed P,
Q R S,
and loose-tooth T.

[P14] 最后走的是
XYZ。
太阳也从椰子树旁
落了山……
然后是
UVW
摇摇晃晃爬出来。
Then U V W
wiggle-jiggle free.
Last to come
X Y Z.
And the sun goes down
on the coconut tree...

[P15] 你听——
叽喀叽喀蹦蹦！
你看——
圆圆的月亮升上了天空！
But—
chicka chicka boom boom!
Look, there's a full moon.

[P16] A 又溜下床，
边跑边嚷嚷：
“你们谁能追上我，
敢不敢和我比一比，
再去爬一次椰子树，
我还能够得第一。”

叽喀叽喀！
蹦！蹦！

[P1] Chicka Chicka Boom Boom
Chicka Chicka Boom Boom
[US] Bill Martin Jr.
[US] John Archambault / Author
[US] Lois Ehlert / Illustrator
Li Yiman / Translator
Guangming Daily Press
1/17

[P2] A told B,
and B told C,
“I’ll meet you at the top
of the coconut tree.”

[P3] "Yay!"
D said to E F G,
"I'll beat you to the top."

"Whee!" said D
to E F G.
"I'll beat you to the top
of the coconut tree."

Chicka chicka boom boom!
Will there be enough room?
Here comes H
up the coconut tree,

[P4] I and J also come to join,
followed by K,
step by step
climbing up the tree.

and I and J
and tag-along K,
all on their way
up the coconut tree.

Chicka chicka boom boom!
Will there be enough room?
Look who's coming!
L M N O P!

[P5] There are Q R S!
And Q R S!
And also T U V!
And T U V!

[P6] Last to arrive are W!
And X Y Z!
Still more—W!
And X Y Z!
All the letters have arrived,
Climbing up the tree—Oh, no!
The whole alphabet
up the—Oh, no!

[P7] Chicka chicka...
BOOM!
BOOM!

[P8] You push and shove, chattering away,
Kicking and stomping.

Everyone runs to the coconut tree,
Mamas and papas,
Uncles and aunts,
Hug their little darlings,
And pat the sand off their pants.

Skit skat skoodle doot.
Flip flop flee.
Everybody running to the
coconut tree.
Mamas and papas
and uncles and aunts
hug their little dears,
then dust their pants.

[P9] ABC shouted:
"Help us up!"
"Help us up," cried A B C.

[P10] Letters crawl out of the pileup: Next from the pileup
D's knee is skinned,
skinned-knee D
E's toe is stubbed,
and stubbed-toe E
F has a band-aid,
and patched-up F.
G struggles out too,
Then comes G
almost out of breath.
all out of breath.

[P11] H and I are tangled up.
J and K are about to cry.
L is knotted like a tie.

H is tangled up with I.
J and K are about to cry.
L is knotted like a tie.

[P12] M is squeezed with legs bent,
N is squeezed into a hunchback,
O is also twisted all over.
You push, I squeeze, chattering away,
Kicking and trampling.
M is looped.
N is stooped.
O is twisted alley-oop.
Skit skat skoodle doot.
Flip flop flee.

[P13] Look who's coming!
It's black-eyed P,
Q R S,
and loose-tooth T.

[P14] Last to come
X Y Z.
And the sun goes down
on the coconut tree...
Then U V W
wiggle-jiggle free.
Last to come
X Y Z.
And the sun goes down
on the coconut tree...

[P15] You hear—
Chicka chicka boom boom!
You see—
A round moon rises into the sky!
But—
chicka chicka boom boom!
Look, there's a full moon.

[P16] A is out of bed,
and this is what he said:
"Dare double dare,
you can't catch me.
I'll beat you to the top
of the coconut tree."

Chicka chicka
BOOM! BOOM!
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《叽喀叽喀蹦蹦》的封面，展示了书名、作者、绘者、译者和出版社信息，背景为一棵色彩鲜艳的椰子树。
[P2] A告诉B，B告诉C，约定在椰子树顶见面。画面中有一棵椰子树，树下有字母a、b、c。
[P3] D向E、F、G宣称要第一个到达椰子树顶，同时H也出现并开始往树上爬，引发对树顶空间是否足够的疑问。
[P4] 字母I、J、K开始爬椰子树，同时L、M、N、O、P也即将到来，树顶空间是否足够成为疑问。
[P5] 画面中，字母Q、R、S、T、U、V正攀爬或位于一棵椰子树上，文字提示它们的到来，树顶空间的拥挤问题持续加剧。
[P6] 字母W、X、Y、Z陆续到达椰子树下，所有字母都开始往树上爬，树顶空间拥挤，引发‘哎呀，糟糕！’的感叹。
[P7] 所有字母都挤在椰子树顶，树干弯曲，字母们发出“叽喀叽喀……蹦！蹦！”的声音，树顶因拥挤而发生剧烈震动，最终导致字母们纷纷掉落。
[P8] 字母们从椰子树上掉落，大家纷纷跑到树下，家人互相拥抱并拍掉裤子上的沙子，场面热闹而温馨。
[P9] 字母们从椰子树上掉落，ABC大声呼救，请求被拉起来。
[P10] 字母D、E、F、G从混乱的堆叠中爬出，各自带着伤痕或疲惫，画面中椰子树下散落着多个字母，表现出混乱和拥挤的场景。
[P11] 字母们从椰子树上掉落，H和I缠在一起，J和K快要哭出来，L打结像领带，画面表现了混乱和拥挤的场景。
[P12] 字母们在椰子树下挤作一团，M、N、O等字母因拥挤而变形，画面表现了混乱和拥挤的场景。
[P13] 字母P、Q、R、S、T出现在椰子树下，准备攀爬，画面中字母们色彩鲜艳，排列在树干两侧。
[P14] 字母U、V、W从椰子树下摇摇晃晃地爬出来，而字母X、Y、Z是最后到达的，太阳也从椰子树旁落山。
[P15] 画面中，一轮圆月升起在椰子树旁的夜空中，文字描述了夜晚的景象和声音，营造出宁静的氛围。
[P16] 字母A从床上溜下，边跑边向其他字母发起挑战，声称自己能再次爬到椰子树顶并获得第一，随后发出爬树的声音。
